profile_text.body:
EHang Holdings Ltd is a public company traded on NASDAQ under the ticker EH and headquartered in Guangzhou. On its own site, the company describes itself as an autonomous aerial vehicle, or AAV, technology platform company, and states that its mission is to make safe, autonomous and eco-friendly air mobility accessible to everyone. It says it serves customers across industries with AAV products and commercial solutions in urban air mobility, including passenger transportation and logistics, smart city management, and aerial media solutions. The site also presents the company as a forerunner in AAV technologies and commercial solutions in the global urban air mobility industry.

The site lists passenger transportation, logistics, emergency rescue, aerial media, and infrastructure solutions among its product and solution areas, along with sections for company news, media coverage, video, partners, investor relations, and careers. It does not name individual aircraft models or give performance figures in the material available.

The company's filings record shows a SEC Central Index Key of 0001759783. No litigation, no tracked products, and no MCP servers are recorded for EHang.
